notes: This is not an upstream corpus. It is the project's own material, recorded as a package source so that authorship travels with the records the way an outside originator's credit does.

sourceSystem is doa_fixture because that is the package contract's enum value for project-authored material. The SRD identities a record answers to live in provenance.coversSourceIdentities, not in sourceSystem.

Drafts are AI-generated under ROADMAP.md's source-restricted independent implementation rule: the applicable SRD record supplies the creature identity, the project's controlled GURPS vocabulary supplies the mechanics, and no third-party conversion or SRD text is an input.
No record is approved automatically. Review status stays review_required until the GCS-fidelity and DOA-playability gates are recorded.
